The classifier did not force it — the declared value itself was R3. Deviation is fail-closed in the safety direction (R3 is stricter than R2; both R2/R3 require canary before promotion), so no operational or safety hole. Graded PASS per precedent (brief-expected-outcome-wrong + fail-closed direction is not a criterion failure) but recorded: S5/S6 planning must use ledger risk_class (R3), and the report's risk labels are factually incorrect and should be corrected at close.
